about: Contract cases for the PreToolUse nudge: claude-plugin/hooks/port-nudge.ts (Node, run as a CLI) and shim/ (Go, `nudge`) must both give each expected result. Read by test/shim-contract.test.ts and shim/main_test.go. 'input' is the hook JSON (a command may be {prefix, padTo, pad}: the prefix padded to padTo bytes); 'stdin' is the raw text instead ({repeat, times} for a long one). 'daemon' is the fake dashboard (the same body for every request; delayMs, refuse). 'expect.context' is the additionalContext printed (null: nothing on stdout); stdout, when printed, is the hookSpecificOutput JSON and a newline, byte for byte. Exit code 0 and an empty stderr are checked in every case. cwd and session are the query values the daemon got (checked when the key is present). 'go' inside 'expect' overrides a value for the Go side; a case with 'split' is one of the three accepted differences (spec: Node and Go may differ only there). The Go side also checks that the query's 'command' equals the command when 'go.command' is given. A case sets PORTBOARD_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS through 'env'; the default here is 10000.
